description.value: The Fort Pub & Grill is a storied neighbourhood pub in the heart of historic Fort Langley, situated about half a kilometre from the Fort Langley National Historic Site trading post. The building traces its roots to the Fort Langley Hotel and has survived floods, fires, and Prohibition, giving it an atmosphere filled with local artefacts and genuine character. Cyclists will find two large patios, a broad menu from wings to salmon chowder, weekend brunch, and delivery or pickup options for those in a hurry.
